newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish yields down, follow foreign markets.
newsitem.headline: Swedish yields down, follow foreign markets.

text.p: Swedish yields fell on Wednesday in line with stronger foreign markets, which were helped by an opinion poll which showed a conservative majority ahead of French elections.
A stronger crown also helped the market, the currency being boosted by strength spilling over from Norway, dealers said.
"The relief in Europe and a firmer crown have been beneficial to yields. A French poll showed an absolute majority for the conservatives", one dealer said.
The French election was still in focus as the market fears a high-spending Socialist government may jeopardise French membership in EMU from the start with looser fiscal policy.
The National Debt Office auctioned two billion crowns of the nine-year bond at an average rate of 7.22 percent.
The six-month T-bill rate fell two basis points to 4.17 percent and the 10-year bond yield fell seven basis points to 7.26 percent.
The crown firmed to 4.4615 crowns to the mark versus 4.4840 crowns on Tuesday.
